analogy.rationale: Laxatives act on gastrointestinal fluid/electrolyte transport and motility, targets and programs not represented in these non-intestinal cell lines, so they should produce little or no transcriptional response; the listed classes are similarly non-transcriptional or act on targets these cells barely express.
